selection_reason: APW-02 completed_verified in PR #417. The owner-approved interleave selects APW-03 immediately before APW-04 and then APM-02.
objective: Define a bounded alpha-useful between-Session Campaign Activity layer spanning downtime preparation, advancement preparation, research, investigation, journaling, relationships, crafting/repair and similar owning-domain work without inventing a generic mutation engine or committing the project to unlimited future downtime breadth.
completion_gate: A bounded alpha-useful activity layer is specified across governed downtime preparation advancement research investigation journal relationship crafting/repair and related owning domains without committing the project to full future breadth.
required_design_questions: What is a Campaign Activity versus an Action proposal, Session Event, reminder, project/task or Personal workspace item?
Which initial activity families are alpha-useful and which are explicitly deferred?
Which activities are immediate deterministic commands, proposals requiring GM/other approval, timed/progress activities, informational records or human-required decisions?
How do costs/resources/assets/ownership remain with their existing domains?
How are start/progress/pause/complete/cancel/expire/stale states represented without a second game-state ledger?
How are downtime time budgets or Campaign calendar advancement governed without assuming every Campaign tracks time identically?
How are Character advancement preparation and final advancement authority separated?
How are research/investigation and relationship/social work prevented from auto-promoting hypotheses, consent or hidden truth?
How are crafting/repair tied to inventory/Asset/recipe/workspace authority without parallel economy truth?
How do notifications, asynchronous approvals, recovery and optional AI reuse APW-02/APM boundaries?
next_action: Execute APW-03 as a bounded design/governance tranche by mapping each initial Campaign Activity family to its owning domain, authority class, progress/time semantics, approval path, recovery evidence and explicit deferred breadth.
